title: Gothic Architecture in Europe
caption: Pointed arches, flying buttresses, impossible windows. Gothic swept from Paris across Europe from the 1140s — and stopped almost exactly at the Orthodox and Ottoman frontier.

title: Romanesque Architecture in Europe
caption: Before Gothic went vertical, Europe built thick walls, round arches and small windows. Romanesque: the architecture of a continent still expecting to be attacked.

title: Renaissance Architecture in Europe
caption: It began with one dome in Florence and spread until half of Europe was quoting ancient Rome. Renaissance architecture, mapped.

title: Baroque Architecture in Europe
caption: Baroque was the Counter-Reformation's answer to austerity: drama, gold and motion. It reached from Rome to Moscow — the widest spread of any European style.

title: Royal Families in the Kingdom of Hungary
caption: 918 years of Hungarian kings in one bar: the Árpáds ruled for three centuries, then the crown passed through Anjou, Luxembourg, Hunyadi, Jagiello, Zápolya — and finally 400 years of Habsburgs.

title: Royal Families in the Kingdom of France
caption: 883 years of French monarchy, three dynasties: Capet, Valois, Bourbon — all descended from Hugh Capet in 987. Then the revolution, and the short strange codas of Orléans and Bonaparte.
